mapper.select: SELECT id,command_id,serial_id,owner_epoch,context_hash,state,version FROM outbound_serial_pick WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND command_id=#{command} AND serial_id=#{serial} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_serial_pick SET state='PICKED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND state='CLAIMED' AND version=#{version}
